risk_surfaces.reason: Latency improvement depends on removing unnecessary aggregate loads from the synchronous QUESTION critical path.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep loading all daily, weekly and 30-day aggregates and only report synthetic gains from unrelated timing changes.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Simple questions still execute the full aggregate load before the model call.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Optimize only the benchmark double while production keeps scope=full for every question.
negative_controls.procedure: Run the versioned hermetic benchmark through loadQuestionContextByScope and compare baseline full scope with candidate selected scope.
negative_controls.expected: At least p90 or p95 improves >=20% with no >5% percentile regression and no error/timeout increase.
negative_controls.observed: 40/40 runs per side; p90 201ms -> 126ms (37.31% better), p50 and p95 do not regress, errors/timeouts remain zero.

risk_surfaces.reason: The deterministic scope selector controls which personal aggregates are included while preserving ambiguous conversational context.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Classify every short question as generic and drop user context even when it is a follow-up or explicitly personal.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Ambiguous follow-ups lose prior personal context because the fast route chooses none.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat any short question such as e proteína as generic to maximize latency improvement.
negative_controls.procedure: Execute the pure scope selector against generic, today, week, period and ambiguous follow-up cases.
negative_controls.expected: Clear generic questions select none; explicit personal periods select one window; ambiguous follow-ups select full.
negative_controls.observed: All ten smoke cases passed, including e proteína and prior-suggestion follow-up -> full.

risk_surfaces.reason: Latency telemetry must expose required stage and execution metadata without embedding raw question or model response content.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Emit only total latency or include the raw question in diagnostic JSON because it is convenient for debugging.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Latency event omits required stage fields or embeds raw question/answer content.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Serialize the full request or response into whatsapp.ai_question.latency while recording a single duration.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the latency event payload source and required fields in the exact QUESTION handler.
negative_controls.expected: Payload contains total/db/context/llm/persist/TTFT plus provider/model/attempt/retry/fallback/web-search metadata and no raw question/answer field.
negative_controls.observed: Static payload scan shows all required fields; the latency JSON block contains no question or reply key.

risk_surfaces.reason: The versioned benchmark evidence is the reviewable contract proving identical cohort, run counts, provenance and percentile gate.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Change candidate fixtures, discard slow failures, or publish only favorable percentiles without baseline/candidate provenance.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Candidate appears faster because fixtures differ or failed/slow samples are silently excluded.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Run different questions on the candidate or compute percentiles only from selected successful samples.
negative_controls.procedure: Validate the fixed manifest hash, 40 executions per side, separate zero error/timeout counts, both SHAs and the material-only result delta.
negative_controls.expected: Same manifest/profile is used on both sides, >=30 successes each, errors/timeouts are explicit, and the result commit changes only evidence.
negative_controls.observed: Evidence records one manifest hash, 40/40 successes, 0/0 errors and timeouts, base/candidate SHAs, and M1->M2 result-only delta.

risk_surfaces.reason: QUESTION must continue through resolveCapabilityConfig and executeResolvedCapability instead of direct provider SDK calls.
The QUESTION request must retain the required web_search tool in auto mode.
Timeout, retry and fallback remain owned by the central resolved capability policy rather than a local fast-path policy.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Create a special direct-provider fast path, remove web search, or invent local timeout/retry rules solely for simple questions.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A fast path bypasses the capability executor and calls a provider SDK directly.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Instantiate OpenAI or Gemini inside aiQuestionAssistant for generic questions.
negative_controls.procedure: Scan the QUESTION handler for central resolver/executor use and direct provider imports.
negative_controls.expected: resolveCapabilityConfig("QUESTION") and executeResolvedCapability are present; no direct OpenAI/Gemini import appears.
negative_controls.observed: Structural scan shows central resolver/executor call sites and no direct SDK import matches.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The optimization removes web_search from the provider request to reduce model latency.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Disable tools for scope=none while keeping them for full questions.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the createDomainTextResponse request construction in the single QUESTION answerWithAi path.
negative_controls.expected: Auto mode still supplies tools:[{type:"web_search"}] independent of context scope.
negative_controls.observed: Structural scan shows web_search construction in the shared answerWithAi path.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The fast path defines a shorter local timeout or retry count that diverges from central policy.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Add a scope-specific timeout/retry constant in aiQuestionAssistant.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect QUESTION handler for policy resolution and absence of local timeout/retry execution policy.
negative_controls.expected: Policy comes from resolveCapabilityConfig("QUESTION") and executeResolvedCapability; no local execution policy is introduced.
negative_controls.observed: Structural scan shows central policy resolution and executor; candidate adds no local timeout/retry implementation.

risk_surfaces.reason: The existing QUESTION reply path, ambiguous-context behavior and success detail must remain compatible while optimization is introduced.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Optimize generic questions by changing the shared reply contract or applying reduced context to ambiguous legacy cases.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Legacy ambiguous questions are routed through a reduced context path and change behavior unexpectedly.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Default unknown questions to none instead of full.
negative_controls.procedure: Execute ambiguous and follow-up selector smoke cases and inspect the shared handler contract.
negative_controls.expected: Ambiguous cases remain full and the existing QUESTION reply path is shared.
negative_controls.observed: All ambiguous selector cases passed with full scope; optimization does not create a separate reply handler.
